concepts.name: ReconciledFormalizationBundle
concepts.meaning: Exact kernel-checkable source and its full source/selection input; construction is not proof execution.

concepts.name: FiniteStructuralPredicate
concepts.meaning: Named graph and typed-reference property checked independently by Lean, distinct from runtime semantics.

concepts.name: LosslessTypedData
concepts.meaning: Tagged values preserve source meanings including UTF-16 identity and ordered occurrences without interpreting user strings as code.

exclusions: runtime assurance by finite graph proof
